name: Recruit-A-Friend allows two links per shared IP address and still links different addresses
contract: RecruitAFriend.SharedAddressLinks (default 2) caps the Recruit-A-Friend links one IP address can hold between
a recruiter and a recruit who both play from it. The recruiter on 198.51.100.7 recruits two accounts on that
address. A third invitation sent while only one link existed is refused when accepted, because the link update
counts the address's links in the same statement. A new invitation to that third account is refused before it
is sent. An account on another address is still recruited.

steps.label: the first account on the recruiter's IP address is recruited
steps.text: Your account is now permanently recruited.

steps.label: with one same-IP link the recruiter can still invite a third account on that address
steps.text: this IP address has reached that limit

steps.label: the second account on the recruiter's IP address is recruited
steps.text: Your account is now permanently recruited.

steps.label: the link limit is enforced when the pending third invitation is accepted
the third account on the shared IP address stays unrecruited
steps.text: Your account is now permanently recruited.

steps.label: a new invitation to a third account on the shared IP address is refused
steps.text: this IP address has reached that limit

steps.label: an account on a different IP address is still recruited after the shared address is full
steps.text: Your account is now permanently recruited.
